meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML. Use this whenever the user wants WeChat article formatting, article preview, WeChat draft upload, image generation for articles, cover or infographic generation, image-post creation, writer-style drafting, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or current discovery of supported providers, themes, prompts, and layout modules.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 一键转为微信公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需将 Markdown 快速排版为微信文章格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account article format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly format Markdown as WeChat articles

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 md2wechat 命令行工具，将 Markdown 转换为微信公众号 HTML，支持格式化、预览、上传草稿、生成封面图、信息图，以及标题建议和去 AI 痕迹等功能。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行微信文章格式化、预览、上传草稿、生成封面或信息图、创建图文消息、标题建议、去除 AI 痕迹，或查询支持的主题、提供者等操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇 Markdown 转成公众号文章格式。
say.note: Claude 会使用默认配置执行转换，输出 HTML。

say.text: 预览一下这个 md 文件在微信里的效果。
say.note: Claude 会运行预览命令生成预览文件。

say.text: 上传这篇文章到微信公众号草稿箱。
say.note: Claude 会检查配置并执行上传草稿操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can invoke the md2wechat CLI to convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, supporting formatting, preview, draft upload, cover/infographic generation, title suggestions, and AI trace removal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests WeChat article formatting, preview, draft upload, cover/infographic generation, image-post creation, title suggestions, AI trace removal, or discovery of providers, themes, prompts, etc.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown to WeChat article format.
say_en.note: Claude will run conversion with default settings.

say_en.text: Preview this md file as a WeChat article.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a preview file.

say_en.text: Upload this article to WeChat draft.
say_en.note: Claude will check config and perform upload.
